{
  "name": "@seitenbau-dev/formulardesigner",
  "version": "1.0.2",
  "description": "React-Komponente zur Erstellung und Bearbeitung von Formularen.",
  "author": "SEITENBAU GmbH",
  "keywords": [
    "react",
    "components",
    "ui",
    "ozghub",
    "ozg-hub",
    "designer",
    "formular-designer",
    "efa"
  ],
  "license": "MPL-2.0",
  "type": "module",
  "main": "dist/formulardesigner.es.js",
  "module": "dist/formulardesigner.es.js",
  "types": "dist/src/index.d.ts",
  "files": [
    "dist"
  ],
  "exports": {
    ".": {
      "types": "./dist/src/index.d.ts",
      "import": "./dist/formulardesigner.es.js",
      "default": "./dist/formulardesigner.es.js"
    },
    "./types": {
      "types": "./dist/src/types/index.d.ts",
      "import": "./dist/src/types/index.js",
      "require": "./dist/src/types/index.js"
    }
  },
  "sideEffects": [
    "**/*.css"
  ],
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "tsc -p ./tsconfig.json && vite build --watch --emptyOutDir false",
    "build": "tsc -p ./tsconfig.json && vite build && tsc -p ./tsconfig.json",
    "build:package": "tsc -p ./tsconfig.package.json && cross-env IS_PACKAGE_BUILD=true vite build && tsc -p ./tsconfig.package.json && node scripts/post-build-package.js",
    "lint": "eslint .",
    "generate-bom": "node scripts/create-bom-directory.js && cross-env-shell \"npm sbom --omit dev --omit optional --omit peer --sbom-type application --sbom-format cyclonedx > dist/bom/formulardesigner_${npm_package_version}.json\"",
    "test": "playwright test",
    "test:ui": "playwright test --ui",
    "start:example": "npm run build && cd example && npm install && npm run dev"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@dnd-kit/helpers": "0.5.0",
    "@dnd-kit/react": "0.5.0",
    "@kern-ux/native": "2.5.0",
    "@publicplan/kern-react-kit": "1.3.5",
    "@tiptap/pm": "3.30.2",
    "@tiptap/react": "3.30.2",
    "@tiptap/starter-kit": "3.30.2",
    "dompurify": "3.4.15",
    "immer": "11.1.2",
    "react": "^19.0.0",
    "react-dom": "^19.0.0",
    "react-hook-form": "7.86.0",
    "zustand": "5.0.15"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@eslint/js": "9.39.1",
    "@types/node": "24.13.3",
    "@types/react": "19.2.7",
    "@types/react-dom": "19.2.5",
    "@vitejs/plugin-react": "6.0.4",
    "babel-plugin-react-compiler": "1.0.0",
    "cross-env": "10.1.0",
    "eslint": "9.39.5",
    "eslint-plugin-react-hooks": "7.1.1",
    "eslint-plugin-react-refresh": "0.5.4",
    "glob": "13.0.6",
    "globals": "17.11.0",
    "postcss-prefix-selector": "2.2.1",
    "typescript": "5.9.3",
    "typescript-eslint": "8.48.0",
    "vite": "8.3.0",
    "vite-plugin-lib-inject-css": "2.2.2",
    "vite-plugin-svgr": "5.2.0",
    "@playwright/test": "1.61.1",
    "prettier": "3.9.8"
  },
  "peerDependencies": {
    "react": "^19.0.0",
    "react-dom": "^19.0.0",
    "react-hook-form": "7.86.0",
    "use-sync-external-store": "1.7.0",
    "zustand": "5.0.15"
  },
  "contributors": [
    "Markus Klein <markus.klein@seitenbau.com>",
    "Markus Hennig <markus.hennig@seitenbau.com>",
    "Andreas Maurer <andreas.maurer@seitenbau.com>",
    "Fabian Willke <fabian.willke@seitenbau.com>",
    "Maksim Sandybekov <maksim.sandybekov@seitenbau.com>",
    "Katharina Blanken <katharina.blanken@seitenbau.com>"
  ]
}
---EXAMPLE---
{
  "name": "@seitenbau-dev/formulardesigner-example",
  "version": "1.0.2",
  "type": "module",
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "vite",
    "build": "tsc -b && vite build",
    "preview": "vite preview",
    "lint": "eslint ."
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@seitenbau-dev/formulardesigner": "file:..",
    "react": "^19.0.0",
    "react-dom": "^19.0.0"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@eslint/js": "9.39.1",
    "@types/react": "19.2.7",
    "@types/react-dom": "19.2.5",
    "@vitejs/plugin-react": "6.0.4",
    "eslint": "9.39.5",
    "typescript": "5.9.3",
    "typescript-eslint": "8.48.0",
    "vite": "8.3.0"
  },
  "license": "MPL-2.0"
}

observation.command: cd /workspace && cat package.json && echo "---EXAMPLE---" && cat example/package.json 2>/dev/null
